headline: Gratitude Dice
tagline: Roll a number, share a thankful thought

scenes.title: Two-Dice Prompt Grid
scenes.say: Roll two dice, match the row and column, and you get thirty-six different prompts.

scenes.title: Rainbow Classroom Keys
tips: Cut in half for two groups
scenes.say: Cut the page in half so two small groups can roll and share at the same time.

scenes.title: Thanksgiving Table Key
tips: Set it right by the plates
scenes.say: Set it by the plates and pass the die around between dinner and dessert.

scenes.title: Friendsgiving Paper Die
tips: Cut, fold and glue the cube
scenes.say: Fold this one into a paper cube, so the die itself tells you what to answer.

scenes.title: Everyday Gratitude Key
scenes.say: Stick it on the fridge and let everyone take one roll before school each morning.

scenes.title: Roll & Write Sheet
scenes.say: Kids write or draw their answer in the matching box, so you can collect them later.

scenes.title: Place-Setting Prompt Cards
scenes.say: Tuck one card at every seat so guests can roll as soon as they sit down.

tips.title: Before you print
items: Card stock for the paper die
Many come in color and B&W
tips.say: Use card stock for the paper die, and grab the black and white versions to save ink.

say.title: Free printable gratitude dice games to get everyone sharing this Thanksgiving.
say.hook: Just grab a die, roll it, and share something you're thankful for.
say.end: Download them all free at printamoo dot com.
